# Managing NCP Connectors

Managing NCP Connectors (84 pages): Managing NCP Connectors

## Chapters
- [Managing NCP Connectors](article_4155442648.md): The NetSuite Connector Platform (NCP) SuiteApp handles the smart data sync between NetSuite and other marketplace or Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platforms.
  - [Salesforce Connector](section_0602040117.md): Sales people can continue to work in Salesforce, and this information is synced with financial and inventory data in NetSuite.
